description:
`MyApp.NotThere.go(1)` with no such module stops the compile with `error[lower/unbound]: compiler2 lowering found unresolved direct runtime callee `MyApp.NotThere.go/1``. `%MyApp.NotThere{}` in the same place reports `resolve/unknown-module: module `MyApp.NotThere` is not defined`, and `String.nope(1)` reports `resolve/unknown-import`. The remote call on an undefined module should report as the struct use does.

Where: `resolve_callee(.., "direct runtime callee")` in src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs (lines ~1579 and ~1841) fails in lowering before the unresolved-module report is made.

Elixir warns here ("MyApp.NotThere.go/1 is undefined (module MyApp.NotThere is not available or is yet to be defined)") and raises UndefinedFunctionError at run time; fz already refuses unknown remote functions at compile time.
title: A call on an undefined module is reported as resolve/unknown-module
